listing.summary: The Mindforge Conglomerate is a secretive faction of psionic researchers, shipwrights, and industrial planners operating from the remote Mindforge Nexus.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with custom ships, psionic officer mechanics, and treatment events.

description:
Mindforge Conglomerate

The Mindforge Conglomerate has opened psionic treatment options to the public. Calling all spacers to transcend. Visit Eden today!

The Mindforge Conglomerate is a secretive faction of psionic researchers, shipwrights, and industrial planners operating from the remote Mindforge Nexus. Once thought lost to isolation, they have begun opening carefully controlled treatment opportunities to outside spacers while expanding their fleets, infrastructure, and ambitions.

Features
- New faction: Mindforge Conglomerate
- Custom star system: Mindforge Nexus
- 12 custom ships with 5 custom ship systems
- Psionic officer mechanics
- Treatment events through comm directories
- New endgame officer treatment loop
- New NPCs, lore breadcrumbs, and hidden story content
- Fractured officer outcomes and rare treatment failures

Ships

Spoiler
Frigates

Destroyers

Cruisers

Capital(s)

Lore

Spoiler

The Mindforge Conglomerate began as a Tri-Tachyon-aligned research effort during the chaos of the First AI War (c+89-c+107). Far from the Core Worlds, one of its survey groups discovered a remote system containing unusual metallic flora and a rare substrate with remarkable adaptive properties. Over time, this discovery became the foundation of everything that followed.

Timeline placement
- During the First AI War: A Tri-Tachyon research splinter surveys fringe worlds and disappears from normal sector affairs.
- Post-war isolation: The group consolidates around what would become Mindforge Nexus and begins studying Aethon and related metalorganic phenomena.
- Early internal breakthroughs: Aethon is refined and incorporated into controlled experiments.
- Human trials: Researchers discover disturbing but useful links between Aethon-derived treatments, cognition, and psionic resonance.
- Ship integration: Aethon substrate becomes the foundation for Mindforge ship architecture, systems, and the faction’s unusual mote behavior.
- Present era, around c+205: The Conglomerate begins stepping out of isolation, opening treatment access to selected spacers while beginning a broader industrial expansion.

At first glance, Mindforge presents itself as a disciplined, elegant, post-human research society. The deeper you go, the more that image gives way to something colder: a faction willing to industrialize transcendence, failure, and human potential itself.

Some Gifs!

Spoiler

The rammy boi has been my favorite recently.

Getting started

Spoiler
Travel to the Mindforge Nexus system.

Check the comm directories on Mindforge worlds for new interactions.

Psionic progression, lore breadcrumbs, officer treatment access, and new faction content are all tied into these contacts.

There is also a small easter egg NPC based on a real-life friend.

If you find him, mention it in the comments.

New endgame loop: visit Wasteland for a chance to offer “willing” officers for treatment. When you’re ready.

Download
Google Drive link https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VCuDzyW-1TQX-gEDxpeTE-ZGSOESty5c/view?usp=drive_link

No dependencies, but highly recommend Nexerelin

Notes
1. This is my first Starsector mod.
2. I leaned heavily on AI tools for Java/API troubleshooting and image generation, then edited things myself in GIMP.
3. The goal has always been a psionic power-fantasy faction with progression and lore, not perfectly sterile balance.
4. The faction is still strong under player control, but I’ve continued tightening some of the more abusive interactions.
5. The long-term goal is still deeper questlines, more event chains, and more bespoke systems over time.

Yes, psionic skills paired with Mindforge ship systems are strong.
That is intentional.

Feedback
- Bug reports and balance feedback is welcome.

Changelog

Spoiler
Ver 1.3 (August 07, 2026)
- Fixed the conflict with the mod KoC due to ships having the same hullID. Thanks IGdood for letting me know!

Ver 1.2 (March 31, 2026)
- Added Director Caelun Voss and new comm-directory interactions at Wasteland
- Added a new officer treatment endgame loop tied to Aethon Substrate
- Added treatment stat tracking, fractures, and disposal outcomes
- Added fractured officer skills
- Fractured officers can now appear among officers recruited from Mindforge worlds
- Added new Master-grade and Ascended lore breadcrumbs
- Added the Maw unlock path and associated industrial storyline setup
- Reworked Mindforge Nexus generation/economy so local industry is less overpowered and the faction’s industrial expansion has clearer narrative purpose
- Added new NPC content and additional comm-directory progression
- Applied balance adjustments to several Mindforge ships and systems
- Reduced mote abuse by preventing mote regeneration while phased
- Slowed mote replenishment to reduce swarm uptime
- Continued cleanup and polish across rules.csv progression flow

Ver 1.1.1 Hotfix (March 28, 2026)
- Fixed an issue where the Mindforge background could apply to other systems and battles until restart

Ver 1.1 (March 20, 2026)
- Expanded the fleet roster significantly with several new combat and logistics hulls
- Added 2 new ship systems that scale with officers who possess psionic skills
- Continued pushing the faction toward a stronger battlespace-control identity
- Reduced the sprite size of the original cruisers (Tempest and Derecho) for better visual consistency
- Reworked the original destroyer sprites (Gale and Zephyr)
- Continued laying the groundwork for future progression systems and deeper faction mechanics

I have a career and a life outside modding, so updates will happen when they happen. :-*
